name: b2b-deal-execution
description: For account executives, founders who sell, sales engineers and sales leaders: decide whether a live B2B deal is on track, what to ask on the next call, who else must be in the deal, what to concede on price and what to send next. Give it your own deal facts and figures; get a deal health score with every point shown as an example default you can change, a mutual close plan on a working day calendar and a 30, 60 and 90 day account plan, discovery questions in your framework (MEDDPICC, BANT, SPICED, Challenger, Gap Selling) and a buying group map, the cost of each concession and an internal selling asset in your champion's own voice, and deal stage email sequences.
